replies.text:
Hi Sir,

1.     Dasabuti hair oil: The plan is 147% of LM, this was taken basis the
central marketing push we saw in Sept. But the push/effect has now toned
down and sales are back to normal levels. OSA wise we are fine, even with
additional segmented discounts it was not possible to get LM level sales.
Also, a big part of the gap comes from Castor coconut, it was a really long
fight to get it configured for 99 store according to the plan. All is
sorted in that segment now.

2.     The spend is higher given two reasons: Higher CPMs and lower OSA of
Rosemary conditioner. One nuance here is that shampoo, hair oil, and
nutrimask spends can also be attributed to conditioners as banner spends
are split amongst the whole hair care category. All in all the problem
centre is Rosemary conditioner, the PO qty has reduced by 90% for it. The
same has been highlighted to Instamart and is being resolved. Regarding AD
spends, pulling the spends is not the best way forward as I mentioned the
spends attribution is split among the SKUs.

3.     Shampoo category is underperforming due to lower units of rosemary
shampoo. Now Hibiscus shampoo saw higher discounting due to QIM sale and
BBD. Rosemary ran at it’s normal price all month and it’s OSA has actually
improved v/s LM. As for the AD spends, pulling the spends is not the best
way forward as I mentioned the spends attribution is split among the SKUs.
The way forward is to balance the importance amongst the category and split
the AD or discount related push amongst all three shampoos.

4.     Yes the spends is earning it’s keep, our Kali mitti face wash and
Anti acne face wash are not matured on the platform yet. As such the spends
is under the plan/target. The spends planned were basis the coverage of the
newly launched Anti acne facewash. The spends are essential to build the RR
of the SKUs on platform.

5.     The guideline discount is incorrect, the MRP is 300 and QCOM sp is
264 i.e the guideline is actually 12% . A few deals were additionally run
to defend the MS of it against Attar ayurveda.

6.     Malai lotion (MNS) sales is up by 71%  (discs were up by 8%) the
discounts were a concious choice to push for better POD availability and WH
orders. This was done in plan with winter SKU plans.
